output.mcnp_status: f=outp; [ -f outp ] || f=out.txt; if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then echo 'NO OUTPUT'; else LC_ALL=C awk 'function clean(s){gsub(/[ \t]+/," ",s); sub(/^ /,"",s); sub(/ $/,"",s); return s} /^ *fatal error\./ && fe=="" {s=$0; sub(/^ *fatal error\. */,"",s); fe=clean(s)} /^ *bad trouble/ && bt=="" {s=$0; sub(/^ *bad trouble in */,"",s); bw=clean(s); while((getline l)>0 && l ~ /^[ \t]*$/); bt=clean(l); if(bt ~ /^source particle no\./){sp=bt; while((getline l)>0 && l ~ /^[ \t]*$/); bt=clean(l); bw=bw ", " sp} if(bt=="") bt=bw; else bt=bt " (" bw ")"} /^ *run terminated because/ && tb=="" {s=$0; sub(/^.*run terminated because */,"",s); tb=clean(s)} /^ *warning\. +no final keff estimate/ && nk=="" {s=$0; sub(/^ *warning\. */,"",s); nk=clean(s)} /^ *run terminated when/ {ok=1} END{if(fe!="") print "FATAL ERROR: " fe; else if(bt!="") print "BAD TROUBLE: " bt; else if(tb!="") print "ABNORMAL END: run terminated because " tb; else if(nk!="") print "NO KEFF: " nk; else if(ok) print "NORMAL END"; else if(FILENAME=="outp") print "NO END BANNER"; else print "NO OUTPUT"}' "$f"; fi
output.mean_keff: LC_ALL=C awk '/final estimated combined collision\/absorption\/track-length keff =/{for(i=2;i<NF;i++) if($i=="=" && $(i-1)=="keff"){v=$(i+1)}} END{if(v!="") print v}' outp
output.sigma_keff: LC_ALL=C awk '/final estimated combined collision\/absorption\/track-length keff =/{for(i=2;i<NF;i++) if($i=="of" && $(i-1)=="deviation"){v=$(i+1)}} END{if(v!="") print v}' outp
output.dkeff: LC_ALL=C awk -v c=2 '/perturbation +k\(trk ln\) +std\. dev\./{split("",m); n=0; t=1; next} t && $1~/^[0-9]+$/ && NF>=3 {m[$1]=$(c); n++; next} t && n>0 {t=0} END{o=""; for(k=1;k in m;k++) o=o (o==""?"":", ") "\"" k "\": " m[k]; print "{" o "}"}' outp
output.sigma_dkeff: LC_ALL=C awk -v c=3 '/perturbation +k\(trk ln\) +std\. dev\./{split("",m); n=0; t=1; next} t && $1~/^[0-9]+$/ && NF>=3 {m[$1]=$(c); n++; next} t && n>0 {t=0} END{o=""; for(k=1;k in m;k++) o=o (o==""?"":", ") "\"" k "\": " m[k]; print "{" o "}"}' outp
output.tally: if [ -f mctal ]; then LC_ALL=C awk -v c=1 '/^tally /{t=$2; v=0; next} /^vals/{v=(t!=""); next} /^tfc/{if(v){r[t]=(c==1?a:b); o[++n]=t}; v=0; next} /^[a-z]/{v=0} v{for(i=1;i<NF;i+=2){a=$i; b=$(i+1)}} END{s=""; for(j=1;j<=n;j++) s=s (s==""?"":", ") "\"" o[j] "\": " r[o[j]]; print "{" s "}"}' mctal; else echo '{}'; fi
output.tally_relerr: if [ -f mctal ]; then LC_ALL=C awk -v c=2 '/^tally /{t=$2; v=0; next} /^vals/{v=(t!=""); next} /^tfc/{if(v){r[t]=(c==1?a:b); o[++n]=t}; v=0; next} /^[a-z]/{v=0} v{for(i=1;i<NF;i+=2){a=$i; b=$(i+1)}} END{s=""; for(j=1;j<=n;j++) s=s (s==""?"":", ") "\"" o[j] "\": " r[o[j]]; print "{" s "}"}' mctal; else echo '{}'; fi
